basic_info.description: Brand new, 2 Bedroom 2 Bath home, plus a Den or home office, with Crane Cove Park and stunning Water Views. Features include Miele appliances and gorgeous marble countertops with a built-in wine fridge. Balcony included. Designed by Woods Bagot, 2177 Third is luxury living that is quintessentially San Francisco and features curated amenities like a landscaped center courtyard, private gym, rooftop terrace, pet spa, residence lounge and co-working space. All photography, renderings & views are representative of the Development.
